opportunities.shortDescription: The Research & Development Internship in Jakson's EV Business provides hands-on experience in electric vehicle technologies, product development, research, data analysis, and innovation. Interns collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to support the design, testing, and development of sustainable EV solutions while gaining practical industry experience.

opportunities.title: Intern - Cloud Operations Engineering
opportunities.eligibility: Batch 2027 • Bachelor's Degree
opportunities.shortDescription: The Cloud Operations Engineering Internship provides hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, Infrastructure-as-Code, automation, DevOps, CI/CD, monitoring, and production engineering using modern AI-assisted development tools.

opportunities.title: SDE I Intern
opportunities.eligibility: Batch 2027 • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
opportunities.shortDescription: The Amazon Software Development Engineer Internship is a full-time six-month internship for students graduating in 2027. Interns work on real software projects involving distributed systems, cloud technologies, automation, scalability, optimization, and security. Interns collaborate with experienced engineers, receive mentorship, and contribute production-ready software for Amazon customers.

opportunities.title: Interns
opportunities.eligibility: Batch 2027 • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering or related fields
opportunities.shortDescription: The Genpact Interns program provides students with hands-on experience working on real-world business and technology projects. Interns collaborate with cross-functional teams, support strategic initiatives, analyze data, conduct research, and contribute to solutions in a fast-paced AI and digital transformation environment. The internship offers mentorship, professional networking opportunities, and potential future employment opportunities based on performance.

opportunities.title: Global Investment Banking Summer Analyst - 2027 - Mumbai
opportunities.eligibility: Batch 2028 • Bachelor's or Master's Degree
opportunities.shortDescription: The Global Investment Banking Summer Analyst Program is a 10-week internship designed for penultimate-year undergraduate and master's students graduating in 2028. Interns work alongside investment bankers on live transactions, financial modeling, valuation, industry research, client presentations, and strategic advisory projects while participating in structured training, networking events, and mentorship with opportunities for full-time conversion.

opportunities.title: Junior Engineer (Intern - 12 Months)
opportunities.eligibility: Batch 2027 • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Related Engineering
opportunities.shortDescription: Cornerstone is hiring Junior Engineer Interns for a 12-month office-based internship in Pune. Interns will gain hands-on experience building scalable enterprise applications, developing frontend and backend components, integrating REST APIs, applying secure coding practices, working with DevOps workflows, and collaborating in Agile engineering teams using modern AI-assisted development tools.

opportunities.title: Software Engineering Intern
opportunities.eligibility: Batch 2027 • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent
opportunities.shortDescription: The Red Hat Software Engineering Internship provides final-year students an opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers on enterprise open source technologies. Interns contribute to real product development, collaborate with global engineering teams, and gain practical experience across technologies including Python, Golang, Ansible, OpenShift, RHEL, AI, GitHub, Java, and Agile development while receiving structured mentorship and technical learning.

opportunities.title: Microsoft Student Ambassador
opportunities.eligibility: Batch 2029 • Bachelor's or Master's Degree
opportunities.shortDescription: The Microsoft Student Ambassadors program is a global leadership and learning initiative for students from all backgrounds. Participants build AI, cloud, and software development skills while collaborating with peers, mentors, and Microsoft employees. The program emphasizes technical growth, leadership development, community engagement, and career readiness through learning paths, events, mentorship, and practical projects.

opportunities.title: Generative AI Intern - Analytics & Innovation (AI)
opportunities.eligibility: Batch 2026 • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics or related field
opportunities.shortDescription: The Generative AI Intern will work closely with Data Scientists and AI Engineers to prototype enterprise AI solutions using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and machine learning techniques. Interns contribute to AI research, model evaluation, secure software development, and technical documentation while gaining hands-on experience building next-generation AI applications for real-world airline operations.
